recognize_zh: 骨髓腔內以纖維性基質為主，細胞沿纖維呈流線狀排列，並散在多顆核深染、形狀扭曲或拉長的異型巨核細胞，脂肪與正常造血明顯減少，為纖維化期MPN的典型切片表現。
features: Fibrotic stroma with spindled cells and hematopoietic elements streaming in parallel
Scattered atypical megakaryocytes with dense hyperchromatic, distorted or elongated nuclei
Reduced residual hematopoiesis with few scattered granulocytic and erythroid cells
Occasional small fat vacuoles and a bony trabecula at the left edge
Extravasated red cells within the fibrotic stroma
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows extensive stromal fibrosis with streaming of spindled cells and residual hematopoietic elements. Megakaryocytes are atypical, with hyperchromatic, irregular and elongated nuclei distorted by the fibrotic background. Normal hematopoiesis and fat are reduced. No sheets of blasts or epithelial nests are seen. Findings are consistent with advanced myelofibrosis, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so the distinction depends on documented antecedent polycythemia vera.
Shows small hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than large hyperchromatic MPN-type megakaryocytes.
Contains cohesive malignant cells highlighted by keratin or other lineage IHC, whereas atypical cells here are megakaryocytes (CD61/CD42b positive).
